canonical_statement: Ritual performance provides a metaphysical support or foundation that prevents the loss of connection to the earthly and heavenly worlds.

attributions.surface_quote: Verily in force and strength and in cattle they find support.

canonical_statement: The Gayatri mantra functions as a metaphysical instrument for the acquisition of spiritual radiance.

attributions.surface_quote: the Gayatri is splendour; verily by the Gayatri they win splendour.

canonical_statement: Ritual structures like the Atiratras serve as protective boundaries to stabilize or secure spiritual states.

attributions.surface_quote: There are Atiratras on either side, to secure splendour.

canonical_statement: The material world possesses a latent desire for propagation and growth which is fulfilled through ritual alignment.

attributions.surface_quote: This earth desired, 'Let me be propagated with plants and trees.'

canonical_statement: Ritual action functions as a mechanism to internalize cosmic principles, thereby granting the practitioner mastery over material outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: Placing the Viraj in themselves, they win food and attain victoriousness.

canonical_statement: The structure of time (seasons, years) is isomorphic to the structure of the divine and the sacrifice.

attributions.surface_quote: The seasons are six, the Prsthas are six; verily by the Prsthas they reach the seasons.

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of interconnected layers of reality where ritual support provides access to higher states of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Verily having found support in the year they attain the gods.

canonical_statement: Ritual structure and linguistic patterns are isomorphic to the structure of the creator deity.

attributions.surface_quote: Prajapati is connected with the Anustubh

canonical_statement: Speech is ontologically equivalent to the Anustubh metre, serving as a vehicle for cosmic attainment.

attributions.surface_quote: the Anustubh is speech; verily they gain all speech

canonical_statement: The physical worlds (earth, atmosphere, sky) correspond to specific temporal and ritual divisions.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jyotis is this (earth), the Go the atmosphere, and the Ayus yonder (sky)

canonical_statement: Human prosperity and the attainment of heaven are achieved through the alignment of ritual action with cosmic order.

attributions.surface_quote: gaining Prajapati by his own metre, go to prosperity

canonical_statement: Ritual performance acts as a mechanism for aligning human action with the structural properties of the cosmos.

attributions.surface_quote: Those, who knowing thus perform the rite, mount openly upon the deities.

canonical_statement: The structure of time and the calendar reflects the fundamental fivefold nature of sacrifice and the seasons.

attributions.surface_quote: The year has five seasons; verily they rest on the seasons, the year.

canonical_statement: Speech is a foundational cosmic force that must be performed in correct temporal sequence to maintain its integrity.

attributions.surface_quote: The twelve-day rite is speech; they perform speech perfectly.

canonical_statement: Ritual action functions as a generative power for the creation of life and offspring.

attributions.surface_quote: Intermediately by means of a ten-nights' rite did Prajapati create offspring.

canonical_statement: Ritual action acts as a causal mechanism for achieving specific metaphysical or worldly outcomes.

attributions.surface_quote: They saw this rite... grasped it, and sacrificed with it. Then indeed did they discern.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the underlying structure of a ritual is a prerequisite for its efficacy.

attributions.surface_quote: Those, who knowing thus perform the rite... discern the world of heaven.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is isomorphic to the structure of ritual components.

attributions.surface_quote: There are six seasons; verily in the seasons they find support.

canonical_statement: Ritual performance allows for the acquisition of sovereignty and material prosperity.

attributions.surface_quote: They obtain sovereignty who knowing thus perform the rite.

canonical_statement: Ritual action functions as a mechanism for aligning human activity with the cyclical structure of time and the seasons.

attributions.surface_quote: by the Prsthas they mount upon the seasons, by the seasons upon the year

canonical_statement: The creator deity Prajapati propagates through the interplay of deficiency and redundancy in temporal cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: Both from the deficient, indeed, and from the redundant Prajapati was propagated.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the metaphysical structure of time enables the practitioner to attain the Viraj and secure material prosperity.

attributions.surface_quote: Those, who knowing thus perform the rite... attain the Viraj, and become eaters of food.

canonical_statement: The ritual performance of the Sattra functions as a transformative process where the practitioner's physical being is systematically consumed to facilitate transition to the heavenly realm.

attributions.surface_quote: In the Sattra the self is the sacrificial gift; verily taking the self as the gift they go to the world of heaven.

canonical_statement: Temporal cycles, such as the year, possess a structural beginning and end that dictate the efficacy of ritual alignment.

attributions.surface_quote: The full moon in Phalguni is the beginning of the year; verily they consecrate themselves grasping the year at its beginning.

canonical_statement: Ritual performance functions as a structural replication of cosmic order, enabling the practitioner to ascend to the heavenly realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The Jyotistoma is the world of heaven... verily by it they go to the world of heaven.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is mirrored in the mathematical and harmonic arrangement of sacrificial chants.

attributions.surface_quote: The Stomas being sung together make up the Viraj.

canonical_statement: Ritual performance establishes a metaphysical foundation or support for the practitioner within the three realms of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: by it they find support in this world... atmosphere... yonder world.

canonical_statement: The human physical structure is isomorphic to the temporal and cosmic cycles of the year.

attributions.surface_quote: Man is of twelve parts... Therefore (the days) follow man.

canonical_statement: The number of breaths in the human body corresponds to the structural divisions of ritual time.

attributions.surface_quote: Nine are the breaths in man; verily they follow the breaths.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions function as a mechanism to align human existence with the cyclical nature of the year.

attributions.surface_quote: The year consists of twenty-four half-months; verily they follow the year.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is immanent in all forms and states of water throughout the cosmos.

attributions.surface_quote: To the waters of earth hail! To those of the atmosphere hail! To those of the sky hail!

canonical_statement: The individual can achieve ontological status as an overlord through ritual identification with divine authority.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art an overlord; make me an overlord; may I be overlord of creatures.

canonical_statement: Divine power transcends the spatial and dimensional limits of the physical world.

attributions.surface_quote: The regions comprehend not thy greatness.

canonical_statement: The altar-ground serves as the symbolic limit or boundary of the physical earth.

attributions.surface_quote: They call the altar-ground the furthest end of the earth.

canonical_statement: Sacrificial ritual acts as the central point or nexus of the world.

attributions.surface_quote: They call the sacrifice the navel of the world.

canonical_statement: The ultimate essence of speech is identified with the Brahman.

attributions.surface_quote: They call the Brahman the highest realm of speech.

canonical_statement: The moon undergoes a cyclical process of rebirth.

attributions.surface_quote: The moon is born again.

canonical_statement: The earth functions as the primary entity that encompasses or envelops all things.

attributions.surface_quote: Earth is the great enveloper.

canonical_statement: The divine or cosmic order manifests form within the formless.

attributions.surface_quote: Making a banner for that which hath none, Form for the formless

canonical_statement: The human physiological and spiritual constitution is integrated into the sacrificial order of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: To expiration hail! To cross-breathing hail! To inspiration hail!

canonical_statement: All states of existence, whether bound or unbound, are encompassed within the sacred totality.

attributions.surface_quote: To the bound hail! To the unbound hail!

canonical_statement: The fundamental structure of reality is composed of distinct planes or realms of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Bhuh! Bhuvah! Svar!

canonical_statement: The Rcs correspond to the human realm, while the Samans correspond to the divine realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The Rcs are the world of men; the Saman is the world of the gods.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed in the present can retroactively rectify errors committed in the past.

attributions.surface_quote: Whatever is done wrongly in the earlier days, this serves to atone for it.

canonical_statement: Ritual acts are mechanisms for the generation and propagation of life.

attributions.surface_quote: The one and the other are drawn, for pairing, for propagation.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed with specific linguistic and structural precision can exert causal influence over divine entities and cosmic forces.

attributions.surface_quote: He who does it first wins the speech, the gods, and the metres.

canonical_statement: The temporal structure of the year is maintained and prevented from dissolution through the ritual omission of days.

attributions.surface_quote: If they did not leave out a day, then the year would fall asunder.

canonical_statement: Ritual acts function as a mechanism for the infusion of vital energy (breath) into the temporal cycle of the year.

attributions.surface_quote: they place breath in the year, and the performers of the Sattra breathe along it.

canonical_statement: The deity Prajapati constitutes the totality of the divine collective.

attributions.surface_quote: Prajapati is all the gods.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed in specific temporal sequences correspond to and secure the favor of divine entities.

attributions.surface_quote: they win the deities who share in the pressing from their several places

canonical_statement: The structure of ritual offerings is isomorphic to the structure of cosmic metres.

attributions.surface_quote: on eight potsherds... on eleven... on twelve... verily they obtain and win the metres

canonical_statement: Specific temporal phases of the day are ontologically linked to specific classes of deities.

attributions.surface_quote: The third pressing belongs to the All-gods

canonical_statement: Ritual sacrifice functions as a mechanism to secure access to the celestial realm.

attributions.surface_quote: verily they go winning the world of heaven by the holy power

canonical_statement: The material world and the celestial world are ontologically distinct and spatially opposed.

attributions.surface_quote: the world of heaven is as it were opposite from hence

canonical_statement: The repetition of sacred verses facilitates the perception and attainment of the manifest world.

attributions.surface_quote: verily they come, gazing on this world by repeating the verse

canonical_statement: Ritual sound and liturgical structure function as mechanisms to restore or acquire metaphysical power and prosperity.

attributions.surface_quote: They won them again by the Kroça, and that is why the Kroça has the name.

canonical_statement: The human physiological structure, specifically the number of breaths, corresponds to and is supported by ritual numerical patterns.

attributions.surface_quote: Nine are the breaths in man; verily he places breaths in the sacrificers.

canonical_statement: The physical limitations of the human body, such as the inability to contract the head, are reflections of specific ritual omissions.

attributions.surface_quote: He sings without the Pratihara. Therefore a man can contract all the other members except the head.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe and the attainment of specific states of existence are governed by numerical ratios and syllabic counts.

attributions.surface_quote: The Viraj is of ten syllables, the Viraj is food; verily they win food.

canonical_statement: The vital breath functions as a singular, unifying force that sustains and protects the entirety of the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: Therefore one breath protects all the limbs.

canonical_statement: Ritual actions performed by practitioners serve as a metaphysical bridge to access higher celestial realms.

attributions.surface_quote: the sacrificers make thus a bridge to mount, for the gaining of the world of heaven.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is composed of multiple distinct worlds that provide foundational support for existence.

attributions.surface_quote: So many indeed are the worlds, and in them in order they find support.

canonical_statement: Ritual action functions as a mechanism to manipulate the distribution of life-force and sustenance between the sacrificer and the created order.

attributions.surface_quote: In that there is the Ilamda, they take away from the offspring the food.

canonical_statement: The human lifespan and physical capacity are structurally isomorphic to the hundred-stringed lute, representing a fixed measure of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: The lute has a hundred strings. Man is of a hundred years of age.

canonical_statement: Ritual speech and sound are ontological tools used to conquer and assimilate the essence of the earth and the divine.

attributions.surface_quote: The voice of the drum is the highest form of speech; they win speech.

canonical_statement: The removal of sin and the purification of the sacrificer are achieved through symbolic physical acts that mirror the shedding of burdens.

attributions.surface_quote: They pierce the hide; verily they remove the sin of the sacrificers.

canonical_statement: All phenomena, whether elemental, temporal, or structural, are manifestations of a singular reality worthy of invocation.

attributions.surface_quote: To earth hail! To the atmosphere hail! ... To all hail!

canonical_statement: The temporal states of becoming, being, and having-been are inherent properties of all existence.

attributions.surface_quote: To that which will stream together, to that which is streaming, to that which hath streamed.

canonical_statement: The totality of existence encompasses both binary opposites and the presence or absence of specific attributes.

attributions.surface_quote: To the toothed hail! To the toothless hail! To the breathing hail! To that which hath not breath.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality encompasses all contradictory attributes and their absences simultaneously.

attributions.surface_quote: To that which hath eyes hail! To the eyeless hail!

canonical_statement: The divine or absolute principle is the underlying substrate of all biological and physical forms.

attributions.surface_quote: To that which hath blood hail! To the bloodless hail!

canonical_statement: Ritual action serves to align individual intent and cosmic forces for the purpose of prosperity.

attributions.surface_quote: Let Visnu yoke thee, for the prosperity of this sacrifice.

canonical_statement: The structure of the universe is governed by a correspondence between deities, rhythmic meters, liturgical chants, and seasonal cycles.

attributions.surface_quote: To Agni, of the Gayatri, the Trivrt, the Rathantara, the spring, offering is made.

canonical_statement: Ritual action functions as a mechanism to appease and neutralize the destructive potential of cosmic forces.

attributions.surface_quote: he appeases it with its own portion, and the cruel fire does not spring up

canonical_statement: The human physiological structure, specifically the breaths and the navel, corresponds to the numerical structure of the universe.

attributions.surface_quote: Nine are the breaths in man, and the navel is the tenth

canonical_statement: Ritual knowledge grants the practitioner the status and efficacy of archetypal beings like Indra or Manu.

attributions.surface_quote: As Indra among the gods, as Manu among men, becomes he who knowing thus sacrifices

canonical_statement: The ultimate deity, Prajapati, encompasses all existence, including both life and death as manifestations of his shadow.

attributions.surface_quote: Whose shadow is immortality, whose shadow is death

canonical_statement: The physical world and celestial bodies are external manifestations or forms of the divine essence of Prajapati.

attributions.surface_quote: Of thee the sky is the greatness, the Naksatras the form, the sun the splendour

canonical_statement: The cosmic steed functions as a bridge between the terrestrial, atmospheric, and celestial realms.

attributions.surface_quote: The steed hath come to the earth... the atmosphere... the sky.

canonical_statement: The individual life force is ontologically linked to and sustained by elemental and celestial powers.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou art the eye; place the eye in me. Thou art life; place life in me.

canonical_statement: The structure of time and the natural order are manifestations of a divine, recurring cycle.

attributions.surface_quote: May the day and night be as of old, the seasons in due order.

canonical_statement: The universe is structured through the harmonious pairing of divine entities and their corresponding physical or social domains.

attributions.surface_quote: as Agni with the earth made harmony, so for me may favourable harmonies be made.

canonical_statement: Divine beings function as mediators who provide protection from distress, sin, and evil.

attributions.surface_quote: To Agni, saviour from distress... to Mitra and Varuna, saviours from sin.

canonical_statement: The physical environment and cosmic forces possess the capacity to grant or restrict existential space for the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: Reverence to Agni, dweller on earth, maker of room; grant room to this thy sacrificer.

canonical_statement: The macrocosmic structure of the universe is isomorphic to the anatomy of a sacrificial horse.

attributions.surface_quote: The head of the sacrificial horse is the dawn, the eye the sun.

canonical_statement: Natural phenomena such as weather and celestial cycles are manifestations of the physical actions of a primordial cosmic entity.

attributions.surface_quote: When it chews, there is lightning; when it moves about, there is thundering.

canonical_statement: The origin and essential nature of the cosmic manifestation are rooted in the primordial sea.

attributions.surface_quote: The birthplace of the horse, indeed, is the sea, its kindred is the sea.

canonical_statement: Knowledge of the symbolic identity of the cosmic horse confers ritual efficacy and ontological status upon the knower.

attributions.surface_quote: He who knows the head of the sacrificial horse becomes possessed of a head.
